verdict.rationale: Oneleet documents scoped service keys for "AI agent automation, MCP servers, and scripts to interact with your Oneleet workspace," and has an official MCP server, so programmatic access for custom tooling exists. Nothing shows that this access can push evidence or test results into controls, and probes found no published OpenAPI/Swagger spec. missing for 10: documented REST API reference with evidence/test-result upload endpoints, public OpenAPI spec, custom-integration guides or examples, independent corroboration of building integrations for uncovered systems.
